# NeuromorphicAuditoryFrontend

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The hardware/software interface that converts acoustic signals into spike-based representations suitable for SNN processing, often using cochlea-inspired filters. Serves as the entry point for speech-driven iNEST systems, determining the quality and latency of downstream neural computation.
